_about.purpose: Cross-project list of organization names confirmed to be product manufacturers, brands, or standards bodies rather than parties to any project. This file is the half of the vocabulary that generalizes: a manufacturer is a manufacturer on every job, so every project that adds to this list makes the next project quieter.
_about.precedence: The per-project denylist ALWAYS wins. If a term appears in both config/denylist.local.json and here, it is redacted. This matters when a manufacturer is genuinely a party — a design-build fabricator, an owner-affiliated supplier — on a particular job.
_about.effect: Suppresses detector candidates (regex heuristics and NER) whose entire trimmed span matches. It never suppresses a denylist match and never removes text on its own.
_about.growth: Append-only in practice. Each entry records the project that confirmed it so a wrong call can be traced and reverted.
_about.tracking: Unlike denylist.local.json this file is NOT git-ignored and contains no project-identifying information — only third-party brand and standards-body names.

entries.source: GLiNER triage crop review and denylist classification

entries.notes: Acme Engineering & Manufacturing Corporation and Acorn Engineering Company are deliberately NOT listed here. Both are firm-shaped and read as product manufacturers, but neither has been confirmed, and this file is for confirmed-safe entries only. They stay on the MLK denylist under the fail-closed posture until someone makes the call; move them here once confirmed.
